rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when you successfully convince someone through reasons or verbal argument.

example.english: I finally managed to persuade him to accept this plan.
example.traditional: 我終於說服咗佢接受呢個方案。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 seoi3 fuk6 zo2 keoi5 zip3 sau6 ni1 go3 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this for urging or advising someone to do something, especially when the emphasis is on the attempt rather than the result.

example.english: I try to persuade you not to go to bed so late.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hyun3 nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 je6 sin1 fan3

rows.note: Use this when you get someone to agree by coaxing, sweet-talking, or indulging them rather than by giving reasons.

example.english: I had to sweet-talk him for ages before I could persuade him to come with me.
example.traditional: 我氹咗佢好耐，佢先肯同我去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tam5 zo2 keoi5 hou2 noi6 keoi5 sin1 hang2 tung4 ngo5 heoi3

rows.note: Use this mainly for formally lobbying or persuading groups, officials, or the public.

example.english: The union managed to persuade lawmakers to support this amendment.
example.traditional: 工會成功游說議員支持呢項修例。
example.jyutping: gung1 wui6 sing4 gung1 jau4 seoi3 ji5 jyun4 zi1 ci4 ni1 hong6 sau1 lai6
